description: One-line plain-English summaries of what happens in each reading, keyed by verse range ('<Book> <start>-<end>') rather than by aliyah, so that ranges shared between an ordinary parsha, its combined (double) form, a maftir and a chag reading resolve to the same entry instead of being written several times. Hand-written, then machine-checked: tools/check_summaries.mjs verifies that every proper name mentioned in a summary actually appears in the Hebrew of that verse range, which catches summaries attached to the wrong passage. Coverage is being filled in book by book; ranges with no entry simply show no summary.

summaries.Genesis 1:1-2:3: Creation, day by day, ending with the first Shabbat.
summaries.Genesis 2:4-2:19: Adam is formed from the dust and placed in Eden, with one tree forbidden.
summaries.Genesis 2:20-3:21: Chava is formed, the snake persuades her, and the two are found out.
summaries.Genesis 3:22-4:18: Expelled from Eden; Kayin kills Hevel and is sent to wander.
summaries.Genesis 4:19-4:22: Lemech's two wives and the sons who founded herding, music and metalwork.
summaries.Genesis 4:23-5:24: Lemech's boast, the birth of Shet, and ten generations down to Chanoch.
summaries.Genesis 5:25-6:8: Noach is born; the world fills with corruption and God resolves to end it.
summaries.Genesis 6:5-6:8: The earth is corrupt, God regrets making it, and Noach alone finds favour.
summaries.Genesis 6:9-6:22: Noach is told to build the ark, down to its measurements.
summaries.Genesis 7:1-7:16: The animals board two by two and the rain begins.
summaries.Genesis 7:17-8:14: The flood covers the earth, then recedes; the raven and the dove.
summaries.Genesis 8:15-9:7: Leaving the ark: Noach's offering, and the command to be fruitful.
summaries.Genesis 9:8-9:17: The rainbow, given as the sign that the flood will never return.
summaries.Genesis 9:18-10:32: Noach's drunkenness and Cham's disgrace, then the seventy nations.
summaries.Genesis 11:1-11:32: The Tower of Bavel and the scattering; Shem's line down to Avram.
summaries.Genesis 11:29-11:32: Avram and Nachor marry; Terach leaves Ur for Charan and dies there.
summaries.Genesis 12:1-12:13: 'Lech lecha' — Avram leaves for Canaan, then famine drives him to Egypt.
summaries.Genesis 12:14-13:4: Sarai is taken to Pharaoh's house; plagues follow and Avram is sent away.
summaries.Genesis 13:5-13:18: Avram and Lot part ways, and the land is promised to Avram.
summaries.Genesis 14:1-14:20: The war of four kings against five; Lot is captured and rescued.
summaries.Genesis 14:21-15:6: Avram refuses Sodom's spoils; God promises offspring as many as the stars.
summaries.Genesis 15:7-17:6: The Covenant Between the Parts, Hagar and Yishmael, and the command of milah.
summaries.Genesis 17:7-17:27: The covenant of circumcision; Sarai becomes Sarah and Avraham circumcises his household.
summaries.Genesis 17:24-17:27: Avraham at ninety-nine and Yishmael at thirteen are circumcised, with every man of the household.
summaries.Genesis 18:1-18:14: Three visitors at the tent; Sarah laughs at the promise of a son.
summaries.Genesis 18:15-18:33: Avraham argues with God to save Sodom for the sake of the righteous.
summaries.Genesis 19:1-19:20: The angels reach Sodom, the townspeople besiege Lot's door, and he is told to run.
summaries.Genesis 19:21-21:4: Sodom is destroyed and Lot's wife looks back; later, Yitzchak is born.
summaries.Genesis 21:5-21:21: Yitzchak is weaned; Hagar and Yishmael are sent away and saved in the desert.
summaries.Genesis 21:22-21:34: Avraham and Avimelech make a treaty over a well at Be'er Sheva.
summaries.Genesis 22:1-22:24: The binding of Yitzchak, the ram, and news of Rivka's birth.
summaries.Genesis 22:20-22:24: Nachor's children are listed, ending with the birth of Rivka.
summaries.Genesis 23:1-23:16: Sarah dies and Avraham buys the cave of Machpelah as a burial plot.
summaries.Genesis 23:17-24:9: The field is deeded over; Avraham makes his servant swear to find Yitzchak a wife.
summaries.Genesis 24:10-24:26: At the well, Rivka waters ten camels and the sign is answered.
summaries.Genesis 24:27-24:52: The servant retells the whole story to Lavan and Betuel.
summaries.Genesis 24:53-24:67: Rivka agrees to go, and meets Yitzchak in the field at dusk.
summaries.Genesis 25:1-25:11: Avraham marries Keturah, dies at 175, and is buried by his sons.
summaries.Genesis 25:12-25:18: Yishmael's twelve sons and the territory they settled.
summaries.Genesis 25:16-25:18: Yishmael's twelve chieftains, his death, and where his descendants dwelt.
summaries.Genesis 25:19-26:5: The twins struggle in the womb; Esav sells his birthright for stew.
summaries.Genesis 26:6-26:12: Yitzchak in Gerar calls Rivka his sister, sows, and reaps a hundredfold.
summaries.Genesis 26:13-26:22: Yitzchak grows rich and the Philistines stop up his wells one by one.
summaries.Genesis 26:23-26:29: God appears at Be'er Sheva; Avimelech comes seeking a pact.
summaries.Genesis 26:30-27:27: Esav goes out to hunt and Yaakov, disguised, comes in for the blessing.
summaries.Genesis 27:28-28:4: The blessing is given, Esav cries out, and Yaakov is sent away to Lavan.
summaries.Genesis 28:5-28:9: Yaakov sets off for Padan Aram; Esav marries a daughter of Yishmael.
summaries.Genesis 28:7-28:9: Yaakov obeys and goes; Esav, seeing this, marries Machalat.
summaries.Genesis 28:10-28:22: The ladder dream at Beit El and the vow Yaakov makes there.
summaries.Genesis 29:1-29:17: Yaakov rolls the stone off the well and meets Rachel.
summaries.Genesis 29:18-30:13: Seven years for Rachel, Leah substituted, and the first sons are born.
summaries.Genesis 30:14-30:27: The mandrakes, more sons, and at last the birth of Yosef.
summaries.Genesis 30:28-31:16: The speckled and spotted flocks; Yaakov prospers and is told to go home.
summaries.Genesis 31:17-31:42: Yaakov flees; Rachel hides her father's idols and Lavan searches in vain.
summaries.Genesis 31:43-32:3: A treaty heap is raised as a boundary; angels meet Yaakov on the way.
summaries.Genesis 32:1-32:3: Lavan turns for home, and Yaakov encounters angels at Machanayim.
summaries.Genesis 32:4-32:13: Messengers to Esav come back with alarming news; Yaakov prays.
summaries.Genesis 32:14-32:30: A vast gift is sent ahead; Yaakov wrestles till dawn and is renamed Yisrael.
summaries.Genesis 32:31-33:5: Limping from Peniel, Yaakov finally faces Esav, who runs to embrace him.
summaries.Genesis 33:6-33:20: The families are presented, the brothers part, and Yaakov settles near Shechem.
summaries.Genesis 34:1-35:11: Dina is violated, Shimon and Levi destroy the city, and Yaakov returns to Beit El.
summaries.Genesis 35:12-36:19: Rachel dies giving birth to Binyamin; Yitzchak dies; Esav's line begins.
summaries.Genesis 36:20-36:43: The clans of Seir and the kings who reigned in Edom.
summaries.Genesis 36:40-36:43: The chiefs descended from Esav, listed by name and place.
summaries.Genesis 37:1-37:11: Yosef's coat and his two dreams turn his brothers against him.
summaries.Genesis 37:12-37:22: Sent to find his brothers, Yosef is spotted and a plot is hatched.
summaries.Genesis 37:23-37:36: Stripped, thrown in the pit and sold; the coat is dipped in blood.
summaries.Genesis 38:1-38:30: Yehuda and Tamar, and the birth of Peretz and Zerach.
summaries.Genesis 39:1-39:6: Yosef prospers in Potifar's house and is put in charge of everything.
summaries.Genesis 39:7-39:23: Potifar's wife accuses Yosef, and he lands in prison.
summaries.Genesis 40:1-40:23: The cupbearer and the baker dream, and Yosef reads both dreams.
summaries.Genesis 40:20-40:23: At Pharaoh's birthday feast the cupbearer is restored — and forgets Yosef.
summaries.Genesis 41:1-41:14: Pharaoh dreams of cows and ears of grain; Yosef is rushed from the pit.
summaries.Genesis 41:15-41:38: Yosef reads the dreams as seven years of plenty and seven of famine.
summaries.Genesis 41:39-41:52: Yosef is made viceroy over Egypt; Menashe and Efraim are born.
summaries.Genesis 41:53-42:18: Famine bites; the brothers come down and Yosef accuses them of spying.
summaries.Genesis 42:19-43:15: Shimon is held, the money reappears in the sacks, and Binyamin is sent.
summaries.Genesis 43:16-43:29: The brothers are brought to Yosef's house, and he sees Binyamin.
summaries.Genesis 43:30-44:17: Yosef weeps, the feast is held, and his goblet is planted in Binyamin's sack.
summaries.Genesis 44:14-44:17: The brothers fall before Yosef, who demands only the one with the goblet.
summaries.Genesis 44:18-44:30: Yehuda steps forward and pleads for Binyamin.
summaries.Genesis 44:31-45:7: Yehuda offers himself as a slave, and Yosef can hold back no longer.
summaries.Genesis 45:8-45:18: Yosef sends for his father; Pharaoh hears and welcomes the family.
summaries.Genesis 45:19-45:27: Wagons are sent, and Yaakov's spirit revives when he hears Yosef lives.
summaries.Genesis 45:28-46:27: Yaakov travels down to Egypt; the seventy of his household are named.
summaries.Genesis 46:28-47:10: Father and son reunite in Goshen, and Yaakov blesses Pharaoh.
summaries.Genesis 47:11-47:27: As the famine deepens, Yosef gathers all Egypt's land for Pharaoh.
summaries.Genesis 47:25-47:27: Egypt becomes Pharaoh's, at a fifth; Israel settles and multiplies in Goshen.
summaries.Genesis 47:28-48:9: Yaakov asks not to be buried in Egypt; Yosef brings his two sons.
summaries.Genesis 48:10-48:16: Yaakov claims Efraim and Menashe as his own and blesses them.
summaries.Genesis 48:17-48:22: Yaakov crosses his hands, putting the younger before the elder.
summaries.Genesis 49:1-49:18: Yaakov gathers his sons and blesses them, from Reuven through Dan.
summaries.Genesis 49:19-49:26: The blessings continue, from Gad through to Yosef.
summaries.Genesis 49:27-50:20: Yaakov dies and is carried to Machpelah; the brothers fear Yosef's revenge.
summaries.Genesis 50:21-50:26: Yosef reassures his brothers, and makes them swear to carry his bones up.
summaries.Genesis 50:23-50:26: Yosef lives to see Efraim's great-grandchildren and dies at a hundred and ten.
